name: Kemokko ~Inu Neko Kitsune~
source:
"Dog"
A loving pet girl pleases her gallant master (the protagonist, a college student) by subduing his morning erection with her devoted attention, body and skill.

"Cat"
A country boy lost in the big city (the protagonist) meets a feline girl in the back alleys. To thank her for showing him where to go, he offers her food, but...

"Fox"
There was once a fox settled in an ancient shrine. She wept for the people who had forgotten the old ways. When an offering was finally made and she went to eat it, a doll appeared...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ065510.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“狗”
一个可爱的宠物女孩用她全神贯注的注意力、身体和技巧来抑制她英勇的主人（主角，一名大学生）的晨勃，从而取悦他。

“猫”
一个迷失在大城市的乡村男孩（主角）在后巷遇见了一个猫科女孩。为了感谢她告诉他该去哪里，他给她提供了食物，但是……

“狐狸”
从前有一只狐狸住在一座古老的神社里。她为那些忘记了旧生活方式的人们哭泣。当供品终于摆好，她去吃的时候，一个娃娃出现了……
